requirements.title: Simple screens in Gujarati for residents
requirements.description: To reduce the risk that residents, mainly elderly, do not use the app, screens must be simple and available in Gujarati, with onboarding led by the Society Manager.

requirements.title: Reminders and auto-escalation for approvals
requirements.description: To prevent an inactive Society Manager from blocking approvals, the system sends reminders and escalates automatically.

requirements.title: Server-side project check on data
requirements.description: The system checks the project on the server side so that one project's data is not shown in another, and this is tested each release.

requirements.title: Watchman-friendly interface
requirements.description: For the watchman, the app uses large buttons, needs only 3 taps for actions, and is in the local language.

requirements.title: Raghuvir Admin override of approvals
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin can override approvals when the Society Manager is inactive.

requirements.title: Society Manager can raise complaints for residents
requirements.description: The Society Manager can raise complaints on behalf of residents who do not use the app.

requirements.title: Deactivate and log fake registrations
requirements.description: The system allows a fake registration to be deactivated and the action logged.

rules.title: Society Manager approval of registrations
rules.description: Registrations need Society Manager approval and a one-flat check to prevent fake registrations.

rules.title: Fixed Phase 1 scope with change approval
rules.description: Phase 1 scope is fixed and new feature requests need change approval; unapproved asks move to the Phase 2 list.

rules.title: Agreed category list for builder vs society responsibility
rules.description: Responsibility between builder and society is decided using a category list agreed with Raghuvir; Raghuvir Admin decides disputes.
